svg.title: Tensile ductility and flexible foils of cubic Ag2(S,Se,Te)
svg.desc: Animated schematic in a black-silver semiconductor palette. Left: a dog-bone specimen is pulled symmetrically, stretches uniformly, then necks at about 97% elongation while slip bands appear; the engineering stress-strain curve below traces in step. Right: a narrow polished foil twisted and closed into a Mobius loop spins continuously about its axis. Not to scale. With reduced motion, a single stretched frame and a still loop are shown.
svg.text: Rolled foil as a spinning Möbius loop
